name: Monster School~ Ecole de monstre
source:
Toma is a brilliant young student who gets transferred to a school composed only ... of Monster.
In this school he will have to cohabit with them and will also have to try to find love there.
translation:
托马是一名才华横溢的年轻学生，他被转学到一所仅由……怪物组成的学校。
在这所学校里，他将不得不与他们同居，也必须尝试在那里寻找爱情。
